dummyscoreboard.configuration.title: Dummy Scoreboard - Config
Identifies this server's modpack to the leaderboard worker. Every server sharing a leaderboard must use the same value. Leave blank to disable reporting.
dummyscoreboard.configuration.modpackDis: Friendly name shown in the global leaderboard's title (e.g. "ATM 11"). Purely cosmetic - leave blank to just show a generic title.
dummyscoreboard.configuration.leaderboar: Minimum time between this server re-checking the worker for leaderboard updates.
dummyscoreboard.configuration.recordDebo: How long to wait after a qualifying hit before submitting it, in case the same player beats it again shortly after.
dummyscoreboard.configuration.workerBase: Base URL of the leaderboard worker (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8787 for a local wrangler dev). Leave blank to use the built-in local stub instead of a real HTTP backend.
dummyscoreboard.configuration.workerApiK: Sent as the X-Api-Key header on every submission, if set. Must match the worker's SUBMIT_API_KEY.
